No.55/1/1/91-Cab.
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA (BHARAT SARKAR)
CABINET SECRETARIAT (MANTRIMANDAL SACHIVALAYA)

#/texts/6.label: paragraph
#/texts/6.full_gt_text:
The undersigned is directed to say that with effect from
20th February, 1991 -

#/texts/7.label: paragraph
#/texts/7.full_gt_text:
(i) Shri Vidya Charan Shukla has relinquished the office
of the Minister of External Affairs.

#/texts/8.label: paragraph
#/texts/8.full_gt_text:
(ii) Shri Shakeelur Rehman has relinquished the office of
the Minister of Health & Family Welfare.

#/texts/9.label: paragraph
#/texts/9.full_gt_text:
(iii) Shri Basavaraj Patil has relinquished the office of the
Minister of State in the Ministry of Steel and Mines.

#/texts/10.label: paragraph
#/texts/10.full_gt_text:
(iv) Shri Bhagey Gobardhan has relinquished the office of
the Minister of State in the Ministry of Human Resource
Development.

#/texts/11.label: paragraph
#/texts/11.full_gt_text: (v) Shri Sarwar Hussain has relinquished the office of the Minister of State in the Ministry of Food and Civil Supplies.

#/texts/15.label: paragraph
#/texts/15.full_gt_text: All Members of the Council of Ministers.

#/texts/16.label: paragraph
#/texts/16.full_gt_text: Copy forwarded to Deputy Chairman and all the members of the Planning Commission for information.

#/texts/18.label: paragraph
#/texts/18.full_gt_text:
Secretary to the Prime Minister.
Special Secretary to the Prime Minister.
Additional Secretary to the Prime Minister.

#/texts/20.label: paragraph
#/texts/20.full_gt_text:
Secretary to the President.
Secretary to the Vice-President.

#/texts/22.label: paragraph
#/texts/22.full_gt_text:
(V.R. Srinivasan)
Deputy Secretary to the Cabinet.
